stories.title: Fact Check Team: Trump and Xi expected to discuss trade, Iran, Taiwan and AI
stories.simple_summary: Leaders from the US and China are expected to meet and discuss several topics, including artificial intelligence and how the two countries will compete in that area.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people interested in international politics — it won't directly affect your daily life or business right now.

stories.title: Heads of AI firms tell UN Security Council that it could be a risk to all humanity
stories.simple_summary: Heads of major AI companies warned the United Nations that AI could become dangerous to all humans if it's not carefully managed.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a general warning about AI safety, but honestly, this mostly matters to government officials and tech leaders — not something you need to act on today.

stories.title: AI leaders warn UN of security risks as systems grow more powerful
stories.simple_summary: AI company leaders are telling the UN that as AI systems get more powerful, they could pose security risks that need attention.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to policymakers and investors — nothing you need to worry about or change in your business right now.

stories.title: Seattle ban on AI-driven grocery pricing sparks warnings of lost discounts from retailers
stories.simple_summary: Seattle passed a law banning stores from using AI to change prices automatically, and grocery stores warn this could mean customers lose special discounts.
stories.why_it_matters: If you shop in Seattle, you might see fewer personalized discounts at grocery stores — but you'll also be protected from unfairly high prices targeted at you.

stories.title: Former WH adviser calls Trump-Xi talks a battle of superpowers as AI race tops agenda
stories.simple_summary: A former White House adviser says the US and China are in a race to lead in AI technology, and this will be a major topic when their leaders meet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people following international competition — it won't change your business or daily life today.

stories.title: ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT's phone app now lets paying users give the AI tasks to complete (like "book my appointment" or "organize my files") by talking to it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you pay for ChatGPT and want help with routine tasks, this new voice feature on your phone might save you time.

stories.title: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
stories.simple_summary: A survey shows that even people who regularly use AI are still worried about it, and using it more doesn't make them feel better about those worries.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just research information — it doesn't change how AI works or affects you, but it shows many people share concerns about the technology.

stories.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
stories.simple_summary: YouTube Music now lets you describe what kind of music you want to hear in plain words (like "upbeat songs for working out") instead of searching by song name.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use YouTube Music, this makes finding the right music easier and faster — it's a handy convenience feature.

stories.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
stories.simple_summary: YouTube is letting users describe what kinds of videos they want to see, and AI will automatically create a custom feed showing videos matching that description.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use YouTube, you'll be able to see videos tailored to your interests more easily without having to search or click through multiple filters.

stories.title: StrictlyVC at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Inside the changing rules of venture capital
stories.simple_summary: A business conference is discussing how AI is changing the world of investing and venture capital, and they're offering discounts to investors who want to attend.
stories.why_it_matters: This is only relevant if you're an investor looking to attend conferences — nothing that affects a small business or regular person.

stories.title: YouTube releases new AI features for creators within its Studio app
stories.simple_summary: YouTube is adding new AI tools to help video creators come up with ideas and understand how well their video thumbnails (the preview pictures) perform.
stories.why_it_matters: If you make YouTube videos, these tools could help you create content faster and figure out what works best — but if you don't make videos, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: YouTube is building AI creator tools that do almost everything for them
stories.simple_summary: YouTube is building AI tools that help video creators by telling them what kind of content to make and giving them suggestions for getting more viewers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you make YouTube videos as a business, these AI suggestions could help you succeed — but for regular viewers or non-creators, this doesn't change anything you do.
